source_text:
5.13
̔Ως ο πλῳ εὐδοκίας ἐστεφάνωσας ἡμᾶς. Στέφανος, φησὶν, ἡμῖν τῶν πόνων χάρις, ἡ
τὸ τέλος τούτῳ, καθάπερ ο πλῳ τινὶ, φράτ τουσα ἡμᾶς.
pass_a_gloss: As with-weapon of-good-pleasure you-crowned us. Crown, he-says, to-us of-the labors grace, the the end of-these, just-as with-weapon some, fencing us.
pass_b_english: “As with a weapon of good pleasure you crowned us” (Psalm 5:13).
A crown, he says, for us of the labors is grace, which — the end of these — as with a certain weapon fences us.

choices.why: LXX Psalm 5:13. εὐδοκία is good pleasure/favor, not ‘of a statue’ (εἴδωλον).

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
